bounded_host_request.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
umask 077
root=/home/admin1/projects/ai-core
p="$root/.worktrees/qwen35-gate-candidate-20261128"
target=d6d7f9893636a9ca752ea0c2bb7a9d2fa7af32e4
base=ai-core-model-gate:local
backup=ai-core-model-gate:rollback-teaching-20261128
candidate=ai-core-model-gate:teacher-d6d7f989
oldid=sha256:e23976a1dd5f4bbb6f57629c7a768e980cbb6b0d515347e07d3b50a2f8fd8898
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' ai-core-model-gate)" = "$oldid"
test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$base")" = "$oldid"
git -C "$p" fetch --no-tags origin "$target"
test "$(git -C "$p" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$target"
tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf -- "$tmp"' EXIT
mkdir "$tmp/runtime" "$tmp/tests"
git -C "$p" show "$target:runtime/remote_model_gate.py" > "$tmp/runtime/remote_model_gate.py"
git -C "$p" show "$target:tests/test_remote_model_gate.py" > "$tmp/tests/test_remote_model_gate.py"
git -C "$p" show "$target:Dockerfile.gate.refresh" > "$tmp/refresh.Dockerfile"
git -C "$p" show 40bb3460dec7ef90ae459dbc9e12d1fcea93be1d:runtime/remote_model_gate.py > "$tmp/old.py"
test "$(sha256sum "$tmp/old.py" | cut -d ' ' -f1)" = "$(docker exec ai-core-model-gate sha256sum /app/runtime/remote_model_gate.py | cut -d ' ' -f1)"
chmod 755 "$tmp" "$tmp/tests"; chmod 644 "$tmp/tests/test_remote_model_gate.py"
test "$(sha256sum "$tmp/runtime/remote_model_gate.py"|cut -d ' ' -f1)" = "$(docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint sha256sum "$candidate" /app/runtime/remote_model_gate.py|cut -d ' ' -f1)"
docker run --rm --network none --read-only --tmpfs /tmp:rw,nosuid,nodev,size=16m,mode=1777 --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges -v "$tmp/tests:/tests:ro" --entrypoint python3 "$candidate" -B -m unittest discover -s /tests -p test_remote_model_gate.py
check_idle() {
 docker exec ai-core-model-gate python3 -c 'import json,os,urllib.request;h={"Authorization":"Bearer "+os.environ["AI_CORE_API_KEY"]}; get=lambda p:json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request("http://127.0.0.1:18185"+p,headers=h),timeout=5));a=get("/internal/handoff/status");b=get("/internal/resources/status");assert not a["resident"] and not any(a["active"].values()) and not a["handoff"] and not a["recovery_pending"] and b["queued"]==0'
}
health() { docker exec ai-core-model-gate python3 -c 'import urllib.request;[urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:%d/health"%n,timeout=2).close() for n in (18181,18182,18183,18184,18185,18186)]'; }
export AI_CORE_CALLER_FILE_EXPECTED_GID=1000
export AI_CORE_API_KEY="$(docker exec ai-core-model-gate sh -c 'printf "%s" "$AI_CORE_API_KEY"')"
test "${#AI_CORE_API_KEY}" -ge 16
compose() { docker compose -p ai-core-gate -f "$p/compose.gate.yml" -f "$p/compose.gate.openrouter.yml" --project-directory "$root" --env-file "$root/.env" "$@"; }
compose config -q
check_idle
if docker image inspect "$backup" >/dev/null 2>&1; then test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$backup")" = "$oldid"; else docker image tag "$base" "$backup"; fi
rollback() { rc=$?; trap - ERR; set +e; docker image tag "$backup" "$base"; compose up -d --no-build --force-recreate gate; echo "TEACHER_GATE_ROLLBACK_REQUESTED=$rc"; exit "$rc"; }
trap rollback ERR
docker image tag "$candidate" "$base"
compose up -d --no-build --force-recreate gate
ready=NO
for n in $(seq 1 15); do if health >/dev/null 2>&1; then ready=YES;break;fi;sleep 2;done
test "$ready" = YES
test "$(sha256sum "$tmp/runtime/remote_model_gate.py"|cut -d ' ' -f1)" = "$(docker exec ai-core-model-gate sha256sum /app/runtime/remote_model_gate.py|cut -d ' ' -f1)"
trap - ERR
echo TEACHER_GATE_REFRESH_PASS_HEALTH_6_OF_6
